title: Google Pixel 6–8 reference research
units: mm; dimensions ordered height x width x depth
source_policy: Published hardware values are from Google Pixel Phone Help hardware tech specs (answer 7158570) where listed, and Google Store specifications for Pixel 8. Visual shape notes are qualitative and cross-checked against locally downloaded official Google imagery listed in image_evidence; no camera geometry was measured.

geometry.screen: flat cover glass; flat side rails
geometry.camera_bar: Full-width bar reaches both side edges. Two camera openings are grouped under one continuous dark visor; flash is a distinct small aperture toward the right end.
geometry.layout: Rear cameras grouped on the left side of the continuous glass visor; flash at right end.

geometry.screen: curved glass edges wrap onto polished rails; visibly more curved than base Pixel 6
geometry.camera_bar: Full-width bar reaches both side edges. All three camera apertures appear beneath one continuous dark visor/glass element; separate flash aperture at far right.
Full-width bar reaches both side edges. Two camera openings grouped under one continuous dark visor; flash is a distinct aperture toward the right end.

Full-width aluminum bar reaches both side edges. Camera glass is visibly separated into a left pill-shaped window for two cameras and an independent circular window for the right camera; flash at far right.

geometry.screen: curved edges over polished aluminum rails
geometry.camera_bar: Full-width aluminum bar reaches both side edges. Camera glass separates into a left pill window for two cameras and a distinct round right window for the telephoto; flash at far right.
Full-width aluminum bar reaches both side edges. Two lenses share a black pill-shaped glass window; flash is separate at the right.

geometry.corners: rounded slab with more pronounced corner radii than Pixel 7; screen corners rounded
geometry.camera_bar: Full-width bar reaches both side edges. Two camera openings share a dark pill-shaped window; flash is a separate aperture at right.

geometry.corners: rounded slab with broad corner radii; rounded display corners
geometry.screen: flat display with very thin symmetric border; flat polished aluminum rails
geometry.camera_bar: Full-width bar reaches both side edges. Google describes the rear array as sitting within a single pill-shaped enclosure on the bar; three lenses share that dark window, with flash and temperature-sensor apertures to its right.

geometry.corners: rounded slab with very broad corner radii; screen corners rounded
geometry.screen: flat display; matte aluminum side rails
geometry.camera_bar: Full-width aluminum bar reaches both side edges. Two lenses share a black pill-shaped camera-glass window; flash is a separate right-side aperture.

geometry_estimates.method: No dimensional camera measurements made. Qualitative grouping/layout was checked against downloaded official Google product/design imagery listed in image_evidence.
geometry_estimates.normalized_guidance: No numeric normalized ratios or mm dimensions included. The phone models can be blocked from the downloaded references; measure a fixed-view image before finalizing any camera-bar span or lens proportions.
geometry_estimates.confidence: High for window grouping and full-width bar continuity visible in official rear images; low for hidden underside/rail wrap shape and any dimensions not published.

image_evidence.description: Official Google portfolio image inspected locally; shows Pixel 6-family back views and full-width continuous dark visor.
Official Google Pixel 7 Pro camera-bar close-up inspected locally; shows edge-to-edge metal rail and separate pill/circle camera-glass windows.
Official Google 7a color lineup inspected locally; shows full-width rail, two-lens pill and separate flash.
Official Google Pixel 8 Pro design mockup inspected locally; shows full-width bar and the shared pill enclosure grouping the rear cameras.
Official Google Camera Bar story image inspected locally; context lineup illustrating the edge-to-edge bars.
